summary: Learn the effective strategies for operationalizing social protection programs. Enroll in our training course to empower yourself and drive positive change.
lede: Social protection program operations connect policy with the systems used to identify participants and deliver support. Designed for program managers, public officials and development staff, this course covers targeting and registration, payment mechanisms, and management information systems. It also addresses institutional coordination, grievance handling, and performance monitoring to help teams strengthen delivery and adapt programs to operational risks and shocks.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals involved in the design, management, and implementation of social protection programs, including:
audience: Social protection and welfare program managers
Government officials in ministries of labour, social
Development agency and NGO program officers
Policy analysts and advisors on poverty reduction
Local government officials and social service coordinators
Consultants and technical advisors in social policy
modules: Understanding Social Protection Systems and Frameworks
Management Information Systems (MIS) and Data Integration
Grievance Redress and Citizen Feedback Mechanisms
From Policy to Practice: Scaling Implementation
